name: 'pi-action'
description: 'Run a durable pi coding agent on GitHub issues and PRs: one conversation per thread, stored in git'
author: 'Carlos Villela'
branding:
  icon: 'cpu'
  color: 'purple'

inputs:
  github_token:
    description: 'GitHub token for API access (issues, PRs, reactions, comments)'
    required: true
  api_key:
    description: 'LLM provider API key (runtime-only; alternatively set provider-specific env vars like ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)'
    required: false
  trigger_phrase:
    description: 'Phrase to trigger pi (e.g., @pi)'
    default: '@pi'
  allowed_bots:
    description: 'Comma-separated list of allowed bot usernames'
    default: ''
  allowed_users:
    description: 'Comma-separated GitHub usernames allowed to trigger pi. If set, users must be in this list.'
    default: ''
  allowed_associations:
    description: 'Comma-separated GitHub author associations allowed to trigger pi when allowed_users is empty'
    default: 'OWNER,MEMBER'
  timeout:
    description: 'Seconds before the run is aborted (its thread is still saved)'
    default: '1800'
  poll_interval:
    description: 'Seconds between checks for new comments while pi works; new trigger comments join the running conversation'
    default: '15'
  provider:
    description: 'LLM provider (anthropic, openai, google, etc.)'
    default: 'anthropic'
  model:
    description: 'Model ID'
    default: 'claude-sonnet-5-5'
  provider_base_url:
    description: 'Base URL for a single custom provider/model (e.g., https://inference-api.nvidia.com)'
    required: false
  provider_api:
    description: 'API type for the custom provider/model'
    required: false
    default: 'openai-completions'
  provider_api_key:
    description: 'Provider apiKey config value for custom providers; can be a literal key or env var name'
    required: false
  provider_auth_header:
    description: 'Add Authorization: Bearer <key> for custom provider requests'
    required: false
    default: 'false'
  model_name:
    description: 'Display name for the custom model'
    required: false
  model_reasoning:
    description: 'Whether the custom model supports reasoning/thinking'
    required: false
    default: 'false'
  model_input:
    description: 'Comma-separated custom model input modalities (text or text,image)'
    required: false
    default: 'text'
  model_context_window:
    description: 'Context window tokens for the custom model'
    required: false
    default: '128000'
  model_max_tokens:
    description: 'Max output tokens for the custom model'
    required: false
    default: '16384'
  compat_supports_developer_role:
    description: 'Whether the OpenAI-compatible custom provider supports developer role messages'
    required: false
  compat_supports_reasoning_effort:
    description: 'Whether the OpenAI-compatible custom provider supports reasoning_effort'
    required: false
  compat_force_adaptive_thinking:
    description: 'Use adaptive thinking for an Anthropic-compatible custom model (required by Claude Opus 4.6+ and Sonnet 4.6+)'
    required: false
  extensions:
    description: 'pi extensions to load: npm package specs or paths relative to the workspace, one per line or comma-separated. pi extensions contribute the model providers they register; packages with a pi-durable extension (pi.durable in package.json) add their tools to the conversation. npm packages are installed into a temp directory without lifecycle scripts. Extensions run inside the action with the job''s permissions and environment.'
    required: false
    default: ''
  trust_project:
    description: 'Let pi-durable extensions trust the repository: load and run its own configuration (such as .pi/ files). Only for repositories whose code you would run anyway; anyone who can open a PR can change those files.'
    required: false
    default: 'false'
  agent_dir:
    description: 'Agent directory (user-level state) for pi-durable extensions, relative to the workspace; a fresh temp directory under RUNNER_TEMP when empty'
    required: false
    default: ''
  worktree_snapshots:
    description: 'Save the files pi leaves uncommitted with the thread (on refs/pi/worktrees/<number>) and restore them at the start of the next run'
    required: false
    default: 'true'
  worktree_snapshot_exclude:
    description: 'Globs of untracked files never to save in a working-tree snapshot, one per line or comma-separated (for example .env*, *.pem, *.key, id_rsa*). Ignored files are never saved'
    required: false
    default: ''
  prompt_template:
    description: 'Custom prompt template with placeholder variables'
    required: false
  output_mode:
    description: 'How to deliver results: comment (post to issue/PR) or output (set action outputs only)'
    required: false
    default: 'comment'
  prompt:
    description: 'Direct prompt for the agent (requires output_mode: output when no issue/PR context is available)'
    required: false
    default: ''
  pr_number:
    description: 'Pull request number to load explicitly (useful for workflow_dispatch)'
    required: false
    default: ''

outputs:
  response:
    description: 'The agent response text when output_mode is output'
    value: ${{ steps.run-pi-action.outputs.response }}
  success:
    description: 'Whether the agent succeeded (true/false) when output_mode is output'
    value: ${{ steps.run-pi-action.outputs.success }}

runs:
  using: 'composite'
  steps:
    # pi-action runs its TypeScript directly, which needs Node.js 24. Reuse the job's Node when it is new enough;
    # otherwise set it up (from the runner's tool cache, so this is quick).
    - name: Check Node.js version
      id: node
      shell: bash
      run: |
        if node -e 'process.exit(Number(process.versions.node.split(".")[0]) >= 24 ? 0 : 1)' 2>/dev/null; then
          echo "ok=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
        else
          echo "ok=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
        fi

    - name: Set up Node.js
      if: steps.node.outputs.ok != 'true'
      uses: actions/setup-node@v6
      with:
        node-version: '24'

    - name: Install action dependencies
      shell: bash
      run: npm ci --omit=dev --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund --prefix ${{ github.action_path }}
    
    - name: Run pi-action
